text: The character dynamics in the provided text highlight the theme of personal transformation as a microcosm of the broader societal upheaval of the French Revolution. Sydney Carton’s shift from a dissolute state to a selfless hero illustrates the possibility of redemption and sacrifice, suggesting that even amidst chaos, individuals can find purpose and moral clarity. This personal arc reinforces the overarching theme that change is possible, both on an individual level and within society, as characters navigate the turbulent landscape of their time.
